rows.label: TEMPTATION

rows.label: DETERRENT

rows.label: ARCHETYPE

rows.label: POPULISM

rows.label: BIOLOGY

rows.label: GIVEN
rows.clue: An assumption that is taken for granted

rows.label: PETTINESS

rows.label: GEOPHYSICS
rows.clue: Geology that uses physical principles to study properties of the earth

rows.label: MEMORY
rows.clue: Something that is remembered

rows.label: DEFTNESS
rows.clue: Skillful performance or ability without difficulty

rows.label: MEME

rows.label: INTEGRAL
rows.clue: The result of a mathematical integration

rows.label: CUTTING EDGE
rows.clue: The position of greatest importance or advancement

rows.label: PHONOLOGY
rows.clue: The study of the sound system of a given language and the analysis and classification of its phonemes

rows.label: SAVOR
rows.clue: The taste experience when a savoury condiment is taken into the mouth

rows.label: HANDINESS
rows.clue: Skillfulness with the hands

rows.label: SCENT
rows.clue: A distinctive odor that is pleasant

rows.label: HOROLOGY
rows.clue: The art of designing and making clocks

rows.label: CORRELATE
rows.clue: Either of two or more related or complementary variables

rows.label: GROUNDING
rows.clue: Education or instruction in the fundamentals of a field of knowledge

rows.label: FIGURING
rows.clue: Problem solving that involves numbers or quantities

rows.label: MAGIC
rows.clue: Any art that invokes supernatural powers

rows.label: SIXTH SENSE
rows.clue: Grasping the inner nature of things intuitively

rows.label: ASTRONOMY
rows.clue: The branch of physics that studies celestial bodies and the universe as a whole

rows.label: FRACTAL
rows.clue: (mathematics) a geometric pattern that is repeated at every scale and so cannot be represented by classical geometry

rows.label: PLOT ELEMENT
rows.clue: A component or element of the plot of a story

rows.label: ROADBLOCK
rows.clue: Any condition that makes it difficult to make progress or to achieve an objective

rows.label: WAVE THEORY

rows.label: SOCIOLOGY

rows.label: ACOUSTICS
rows.clue: The study of the physical properties of sound

rows.label: ALPHA TEST

rows.label: DYNAMICS

rows.label: CHEMISTRY
